source: ten field savestates, five of them taken 2026-07-30 and never used to build the model
method: for each field, locate every per-room seed in the reconstructed RNG stream, walk back a recorded number of draws to the generation start, and run tools/generate.py's forward simulation from there. The offset is stored so this can be re-derived in a second rather than by searching 400 candidates.
WHAT_IT_SETTLES: the drawn TARGET is now readable for every field, and the generator never reaches it. Ten fields, ten shortfalls, not one of them zero.
target_draw_confirmed_out_of_sample: the ten targets are 10, 10, 10, 10, 11, 11, 11, 12, 12, 12 - four, three and three - which is what 10 + rand(3) should produce. So the draw model is right and the defect is entirely in the stopping rule.
THE_SHORTFALL_HAS_TWO_PARTS: every field with target 10 has exactly 9 rooms, four times out of four - a constant one-room shortfall. But the mean shortfall rises with the target: 1.0 at target 10, 2.33 at 11, 3.0 at 12, and no field in ten has more than 10 rooms while targets reach 12. That is the signature of a CAP near ten rooms sitting on top of the constant one, not of a single missing exit condition.
containment: the simulation's cell set CONTAINS the field's in 7 of 10, including 3 of the 5 unseen fields. So the growth model places the right rooms and then keeps going; it does not place different ones.
THE_LOOP_STOPS_ONE_SHORT_OF_TARGET: re-running the offset search with the exit test at target, target-1 and target-2 settles which. target-1 is the ONLY one of the three that reproduces any field exactly - cells and count - and it reproduces THREE, each at a single offset out of four hundred. At target and at target-2, nothing reproduces at all, which is where this model sat for many iterations. tools/generate.py now stops at target-1 and its own --check goes from 0/5 to 2/5.
WHAT_IS_STILL_MISSING: the other seven fields. Their shortfalls grow with the target - mean 1.0 at target 10, 2.33 at 11, 3.0 at 12 - and no field in ten exceeds 10 rooms while targets reach 12, so a cap near ten rooms is still unmodelled. Note also that two fields with target 10 and shortfall 1 do NOT reproduce: their placement path diverges before the end, so the off-by-one is not the only difference in those.
CORRECTION_the_ten_field_statistics_were: the previous entry reported targets 10,10,10,10,11,11,11,12,12,12 and shortfalls 1..4 across ten fields, and concluded the shortfall grows with the target. That is withdrawn. For a field that does not reproduce, the offset is chosen by maximising cell overlap - and MEASURED across all 400 candidate offsets, the recovered target is near-uniform over {10,11,12} in EVERY field, about a third each. So a fitted offset picks the target as much as it picks anything: the recovered target for a non-reproducing field carries no information. The four/three/three spread that looked like confirmation of 10+rand(3) is what sampling roughly-uniform offsets produces, and the rising shortfall follows mechanically from pairing larger fitted targets with the same real room counts.
WHAT_SURVIVES: the three fields that reproduce EXACTLY. Their offsets are pinned by the reproduction itself rather than fitted, so their targets are real: 10, 10 and 11 against 9, 9 and 10 rooms. Shortfall exactly one, three times out of three. And the exit-rule comparison survives because it is a SEARCH-level result, not a per-offset one: over the same 400 offsets in the same ten fields, stopping at target-1 yields three exact reproductions while stopping at target or target-2 yields none.
BUDGET_EXHAUSTION_REFUTED: tested as an alternative stop: growth ends when the branch and linear budgets both reach zero. Zero exact reproductions in ten fields. Adding it as an extra condition alongside target-1 changes nothing, so the budget never runs out first - it is inert as a stopping rule.
THE_CAP_CLAIM_IS_WITHDRAWN: 'no field exceeds 10 rooms while targets reach 12, so there is a cap near ten rooms' rested on the fitted targets. With those gone, the only honest statement is that seven fields do not reproduce and the reason is unknown - two of them have the right room count but a divergent placement path, which is not a stopping problem at all.
CORRECTION_2_the_target_minus_1_RESULT_I: calibration kills it. Searching out to 2000 offsets per field - far past any plausible generation start, since placement costs about 100 draws - an exact cell-set match occurs 5 times in 20,000 runs, one in four thousand, and two of those five are at offsets 700 and 1804 which cannot be real. A 400-offset window across ten fields is exactly four thousand runs, so chance predicts ONE match. Three is a Poisson tail of about 8 percent. tools/generate.py is back to the disassembly's `target`.
THE_SHARP_INSTRUMENT_IS_DRAW_ACCOUNTING: the gap between generation start and the first per-room seed is fixed by the stream and owes nothing to the field's shape. Requiring the model to consume exactly that many draws - its placement draws plus the first transcribed room's pre-seed draws - admits at most ONE candidate offset per field. At those offsets the model never reproduces the field, and at the three cell-matching offsets its draw count was off by 25, 23 and -95. The model can match the layout or the draw count, never both, which means it is wrong somewhere rather than merely stopping at the wrong count.

RESOLVED_LIVE_2026_07_30.breakpoint: 0x02081ed4, the `str r1,[r5,r0]` that stores the drawn target into gen+0x87c
RESOLVED_LIVE_2026_07_30.r0: 0x87c every time, which confirms the store
RESOLVED_LIVE_2026_07_30.placed_equals_target: gen+0x878 reads 8 against a stored 8 in every trial that was read back
RESOLVED_LIVE_2026_07_30.WHAT_IT_OVERTURNS: this item predicted that if the live read came back 9 then every static derivation of the target is wrong. It came back 9, then 8 four times. And placed == target means the whole 'the generator never reaches its target' line - two iterations of shortfall statistics, the cap near ten rooms, the fitted target-1 exit rule - was one wrong constant wearing three costumes.
RESOLVED_LIVE_2026_07_30.why_four_trials_agree: the same savestate replayed is deterministic; the 9 came from confirming at a different frame, since the RNG advances every frame
RESOLVED_LIVE_2026_07_30.consistency_with_the_savestates: the ten fields hold 8,8,8,9,9,9,9,9,10,10 rooms, which under placed == target means targets of 8 to 10 - and three fields at 8 are impossible under the old {10,11,12}
RESOLVED_LIVE_2026_07_30.relationship_to_bb3f5f0: a concurrent iteration found the static cause in parallel: pass 3 of the three-pass merge in FUN_02031ce8, the sparse per-area diff from quest/single/dive/quest_001SS00.rel, overrides the range the simulator was reading, and valley's real range is 8 to 10. This live read is the independent confirmation of it - 8 and 9 sit inside 8..10 and outside 10..12 - and adds the half that a static fix cannot show directly: gen+0x878 equals gen+0x87c, so the generator reaches its target exactly and there was never a shortfall.

THE_SAVESTATE_LOADING_RECIPE_THAT_WORKS: the ss13 build does load a state through F8, but only once emulation is properly under way. Boot with --state (which installs it as slot 8), wait for the title screen, press START ONCE, wait a couple of seconds, and only then send --load-state 8. Loading immediately after boot silently does nothing, which is what made this look like a dead end for several iterations. Verified by screenshot - the DS screen changes by 97% - and by reading the player position back as the guild counter with the name Aiya.
